svg.title: A discovery-driven system
svg.desc: Comparison of a query-driven Co-Scientist run with LIA's discovery-driven cycle, a table of six system parts read off the cycle with what exists in the lineage, and unit charts of how many candidates were rejected.
svg.text: EDGELESS LAB / LATENT INFORMATION ARCHAEOLOGY / PLATE IV-05-1
A discovery-driven system is the cycle kept running
A query-driven run is handed its question and stops when that question is answered. LIA asks for a persistent system that searches for questions worth asking, and that
rejects more than it accepts when the evidence warrants it.
A scientist writes a research goal
less than one hour of an expert clinician's time
the kind of proposals wanted, and the criteria
Generation, Reflection, Ranking, Proximity among them
ranked hypotheses and a research overview
roughly three hours for the leukemia study
the run ends; the next run needs a new goal
DISCOVERY-DRIVEN: SIX PARTS ON ONE LOOP
WHAT ALREADY EXISTS IN THE LINEAGE

A query hands the system its boundary. Here the

Arrowsmith lists the title terms two literatures share.
Co-Scientist's Proximity agent graphs how close its hypotheses
The first maps the corpus, the second the system's own
output. A discovery-driven system needs the first kind.
Arrowsmith's one-node search, “a way of generating new
hypotheses.” Sourati and Evans (2023) tune a model away from
A person still chose the amygdala and fear
Co-Scientist's Reflection agent searches previous work, weighs
the evidence for and against, and filters out non-novel
hypotheses when the goal asks for novelty.
It works inside a run that serves one goal.
Co-Scientist's Elo rating ranks its hypotheses, and it is
auto-evaluated, not based on independent ground truth.
The independent evaluation came from outside the
system: experts who chose candidates, and laboratory
The eighth principle keeps rejected hypotheses “so future
investigators do not repeat the same excavation.”
A system that runs indefinitely is its own future
Generation is the cheap part. The cases show the proportions when the systems are used well.
